## Stepwise TPC

Initial data processing and plotting by JA on 10/14/26. Using [code](https://github.com/JillAshey/PI_TPC/blob/main/scripts/TPC_Photosynthesis.Rmd) from 2025 TPC paper as reference. 

### Functions for analysis 

```{r}
sharpe_schoolfield <- function(lnc, E, Eh, Th, temp, Tc) {
  Tc <- 273.15 + Tc
  k <- 8.62e-5
  boltzmann.term <- lnc + log(exp(E/k*(1/Tc - 1/temp))) # units are eV/K, electrovolts/Kelvin
  inactivation.term <- log(1/(1 + exp(Eh/k*(1/Th - 1/temp))))
  return(boltzmann.term + inactivation.term)}

get_topt <- function(E, Th, Eh){
  k <- 8.62e-05
  return((Eh * Th) / (Eh + (k * Th * log((Eh / E) - 1))))}

get_tpc_ci <- function(model, new_data) {
  # predictNLS calculates the intervals based on the Taylor expansion (Delta Method)
  pred <- predictNLS(model, newdata = new_data, interval = "confidence", alpha = 0.05)
  return(as.data.frame(pred$summary))}
```

### Prep data 

Load run metadata 
```{r}
run_meta <- read_csv("../data/Stepwise/run_metadata_stepwise.csv") %>%
  mutate(
    Start = as_datetime(Date) + hours(hour(Start.time)) + minutes(minute(Start.time)),
    Stop  = as_datetime(Date) + hours(hour(Stop.time)) + minutes(minute(Stop.time)))
```

Load sample metadata 
```{r}
sample_meta <- read_csv("../data/Stepwise/sample_metadata_stepwise.csv")

# Make sure Chamber well # is numeric
sample_meta <- sample_meta %>%
  mutate(`Chamber` = as.numeric(`Chamber`))
```

List all raw files for Sept 2023 
```{r}
files <- list.files(path = "../data/Stepwise/raw_data/", pattern = "*.csv", full.names = TRUE)
```

Join O2 data with metadata files based on start and stop times 
```{r}
all_data <- map_dfr(files, function(f) {
  # Extract channel number from filename, e.g. Ch1 → 1
  channel <- str_extract(f, "Ch\\d+") %>% str_remove("Ch") %>% as.numeric()
  
  # Read the file
  raw <- read_csv(f) %>%
    mutate(
      # Parse datetime (adjust format if needed)
      DateTime = dmy_hms(Date),
      Channel = channel
    )
  
  # Join to run metadata by fuzzy time match
  raw_joined <- fuzzy_left_join(
    raw,
    run_meta,
    by = c("DateTime" = "Start", "DateTime" = "Stop"),
    match_fun = list(`>=`, `<=`)
  )
  
  # Join to sample metadata by Date, Run #, and Channel
  raw_joined <- raw_joined %>%
    left_join(
      sample_meta,
      by = c(
        "Date.y" = "Date",
        "Run" = "Run",
        "Channel" = "Chamber"
      )
    )
  
  return(raw_joined)
})
```

Remove any time errors in the data. For this dataset specifically:

- For all temps: remove first ~3 mins (time when coral was acclimating to being handled)
- For temp 25: Remove the last ~30 mins of channel 9! The probe came out halfway through and I did not notice until end of run
- For temp 34: Remove the last 30 seconds of this run for all probes. I pulled out probes before stopping software
- Remove any rows with sampleID as NA
```{r}
cleaned_data <- all_data %>%
  filter(!is.na(SampleID)) %>%
  group_by(Run, Channel, SampleID) %>%
  filter(`Delta T [min]` >= 3) %>% # acclimation time
  filter(!(Target_Temperature == 25 & Channel == 9 & `Delta T [min]` > (max(`Delta T [min]`) - 30))) %>%
  filter(!(Target_Temperature == 34 & `Delta T [min]` > (max(`Delta T [min]`) - 0.5))) %>%
  ungroup()
```

### Run localized linear regressions 

The interval fitting code is computationally intense.

Make list of all SampleID / Run combinations (including blanks)
```{r}
sample_runs <- cleaned_data %>%
  filter(!is.na(SampleID)) %>%
  distinct(SampleID, Run)
```

Calculate interval slopes for blanks
```{r}
blank_data <- cleaned_data %>%
  filter(SampleID == "blank")

blank_intervals_thinned <- blank_data %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(SampleID)) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Run, Temperature.y) %>%
  dplyr::slice(seq(1, n(), by = 5)) %>% # Thin data 
  dplyr::group_split()
```

Fit regressions and extract slopes for each blank interval
```{r}
# regression function
fit_reg <- function(df) {
  rankLocReg(
    xall = as.numeric(df$`Delta T [min]`),
    yall = df$Oxygen,
    alpha = 0.2,
    method = "pc",
    verbose = FALSE
  )
}

# Fit regressions for each blank interval
plan(multisession)
blank_fits <- future_map(blank_intervals_thinned, fit_reg, .options = furrr_options(seed = TRUE))
#blank_fits <- map(blank_intervals, fit_reg)
blank_slopes <- map_dbl(blank_fits, ~ pluck(., "allRegs", "b1", 1))

# Create a summary table mapped by Run & Temperature
blank_summary <- map2_dfr(
  blank_intervals_thinned,
  blank_slopes,
  ~ tibble(
    Run = unique(.x$Run),
    Temperature = unique(.x$Temperature.y),
    Blank_Slope = .y
  )
)
```

Fit regressions for each interval/samples
```{r}
# Thin sample data (take 1 of every 5 rows to prevent rankLocReg bottleneck)
thinned_data <- cleaned_data %>%
  group_by(SampleID, Run, Temperature.y) %>%
  slice(seq(1, n(), by = 5)) %>%
  ungroup()

# Define interval fitting function matching Run & Temperature blanks
fit_colony_intervals_runblank <- function(colony_id, run_num) {
  # Subset sample data for specific colony & run
  sample_data <- thinned_data %>%
    filter(SampleID == colony_id, Run == run_num)
  
  if (nrow(sample_data) == 0) return(NULL)
  
  # Split data by temperature interval
  intervals <- sample_data %>%
    group_by(Temperature.y) %>%
    group_split()
  
  # Fit regressions
  fits <- map(intervals, fit_reg)
  micromol.L.s <- map_dbl(fits, ~ pluck(., "allRegs", "b1", 1))
  
  # Build detailed summary
  interval_df <- map2_dfr(
    intervals,
    seq_along(intervals),
    ~ tibble(
      SampleID    = colony_id,
      Run         = run_num,
      Interval    = .y,
      Temperature = unique(.x$Temperature.y),
      N_points    = nrow(.x),
      O2_start    = head(.x$Oxygen, 1),
      O2_end      = tail(.x$Oxygen, 1), DeltaT_min  = min(.x$`Delta T [min]`),
      DeltaT_max  = max(.x$`Delta T [min]`),
      O2_min      = min(.x$Oxygen, na.rm = TRUE),
      O2_max      = max(.x$Oxygen, na.rm = TRUE),
      Slope       = micromol.L.s[.y]
    )
  ) %>%
    # Match the specific blank for specific Run and Temperature
    left_join(blank_summary, by = c("Run", "Temperature")) %>%
    mutate(
      Blank_Corrected_Slope = Slope - Blank_Slope
    )
  
  # Write individual sample CSVs
  fn <- paste0("../output/Stepwise/intervals_", colony_id, "_run", run_num, ".csv")
  write_csv(interval_df, fn)
  
  interval_df
}

# Run parallelized execution for all samples
plan(multisession)

# Build run pairs list excluding blank entries
colony_runs_clean <- thinned_data %>%
  filter(!is.na(SampleID), SampleID != "blank") %>%
  distinct(SampleID, Run)

all_interval_summaries <- future_pmap_dfr(
  list(colony_runs_clean$SampleID, colony_runs_clean$Run),
  fit_colony_intervals_runblank
)

# Export final combined results
write_csv(all_interval_summaries, "../output/Stepwise/all_interval_summaries.csv")

getwd()
```

Read data in so I don't have to run above chunk again 
```{r}
all_int_tpc <- read_csv("../output/Stepwise/all_interval_summaries.csv")

all_int_tpc$SampleID <- as.character(all_int_tpc$SampleID)
```

Merge sample metadata with interval data 
```{r}
all_int_tpc <- all_int_tpc %>%
  inner_join(sample_meta, by = c("SampleID" = "SampleID", "Temperature" = "Target_Temperature"))
```

Normalize interval data by chamber volume and surface area and save. Since I don't have the surface area yet, normalized to 15cm2 for all fragments. 
```{r}
all_int_tpc <- all_int_tpc %>%
  mutate(
    Chamber_Volume_L = Chamber_Volume_mL / 1000,  # mL → L
    Slope_norm = (Blank_Corrected_Slope * Chamber_Volume_L / 15) * 60) # units are umol O2 cm-2 h-1
write.csv(all_int_tpc, "../output/Stepwise/all_interval_summaries_normalized.csv")
```

Multiply by -1 so values are positive 
```{r}
all_int_tpc <- all_int_tpc %>%
  mutate(Slope_norm_pos = -1 * Slope_norm)
```

Plot curves across temperatures
```{r}
ggplot(all_int_tpc, aes(x = Temperature, y = Slope_norm_pos)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, alpha = 0.5, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_point() +
  geom_line(aes(group = SampleID)) + 
  #scale_color_manual(
  #  values = c("Resistant" = "#4b294fff", "Susceptible" = "#f3a17dff")) +
  #facet_wrap(~Species, scales = "fixed") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  labs(x = "Temperature (C)", y = "umol O2 cm-2 h-1")

ggplot(all_int_tpc, aes(x = Temperature, y = Slope_norm_pos)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, alpha = 0.5, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.4, size = 1.5) +

  labs(x = "Temperature (C)", y = "umol O2 cm-2 h-1") +

```

## Fit TPC curve 

Set target temperature to numeric and convert temperature to Kelvin
```{r}
all_int_tpc <- all_int_tpc %>%
  mutate(
    Temperature = as.numeric(Temperature),
    Temperature.K = Temperature + 273.15,
    log.rate = log(Slope_norm_pos)) # take log of positive rate 
```

Fit curves for all colonies using `sharpe_schoolfield` function defined above
```{r}
fits <- all_int_tpc %>%
  group_by(SampleID) %>%
  nest() %>%
  mutate(fit = purrr::map(data, ~ nls_multstart(
    log.rate ~ sharpe_schoolfield(lnc, E, Eh, Th, temp = Temperature.K, Tc = 27),
    data = .x,
    iter = 1000,
    start_lower = c(lnc = -5, E = 0.2, Eh = 0.5, Th = 290),
    start_upper = c(lnc = 5,  E = 1.2, Eh = 4.0, Th = 315),
    lower       = c(lnc = -10, E = 0.05, Eh = 0.1, Th = 273.15),
    upper       = c(lnc = 10,  E = 3.0,  Eh = 10,  Th = 350),
    supp_errors = 'Y',
    na.action   = na.omit
  )))
```

Extract fit parameters
```{r}
params <- fits %>%
  mutate(coefs = map(fit, tidy)) %>%
  select(SampleID, coefs) %>%
  unnest(coefs)
```

Calculate Topt and Rmax for each colony 
```{r}
Topt_Rmax <- params %>%
  select(SampleID, term, estimate) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = term, values_from = estimate) %>%
  mutate(
    Topt_K = get_topt(E, Th, Eh),
    Topt_C = Topt_K - 273.15,
    Rmax_log = sharpe_schoolfield(lnc, E, Eh, Th, temp = Topt_K, Tc = 27),
    Rmax_linear = exp(Rmax_log))
```

Pivot data so that each trait is a row 
```{r}
traits_long <- Topt_Rmax %>%
  dplyr::select(SampleID, lnc, E, Eh, Topt_C, Rmax_log, Rmax_linear) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(lnc, E, Eh, Topt_C, Rmax_log, Rmax_linear), 
               names_to = "trait", 
               values_to = "estimate") %>%
  mutate(Type = "Stepwise")
```

Save as csv
```{r}
write.csv(traits_long, "../output/Stepwise/Stepwise_TPC_metrics.csv")
```

Plot with confidence intervals 
```{r}
# Define the temperature range for the smooth curves
new_data <- data.frame(
  Temperature.K = seq(18 + 273.15 - 1,  # 17°C
                      38 + 273.15 + 1,  # 39°C
                      length.out = 200))

# Generate predictions for every model -- This creates a "long" dataframe of all potential curves
preds_all <- fits %>%
  mutate(preds = map(fit, ~{
    p <- try(predict(.x, newdata = new_data), silent = TRUE)
    if(inherits(p, "try-error")) return(NULL)
    data.frame(Temperature.K = new_data$Temperature.K, pred_val = p)
  })) %>%
  filter(!map_lgl(preds, is.null)) %>% # Remove failed fits
  unnest(preds)

# Calculate the mean and CI of the curves per temp
# At each temperature step, find the mean performance across all samples
preds_mean_summary <- preds_all %>%
  group_by(Temperature.K) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    mean_val = mean(pred_val, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_val = sd(pred_val, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = n(),
    se_val = sd_val / sqrt(n),
    # 95% Confidence Interval of the Mean
    lower = mean_val - (1.96 * se_val),
    upper = mean_val + (1.96 * se_val),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

Plot TPC with fitted curves 
```{r}
ggplot(preds_mean_summary, aes(x = Temperature.K - 273.15, y = mean_val)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, alpha = 0.5, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lower, ymax = upper), alpha = 0.5, color = NA) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.5) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = seq(18, 40, by = 2), 
    limits = c(17, 40)) +
  geom_point(data = all_int_tpc, aes(x = Temperature.K - 273.15, y = log.rate), 
             alpha = 0.2, size = 1, inherit.aes = TRUE) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white"),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
    panel.grid = element_blank()
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Temperature (°C)", 
    y = expression(bold("Respiration (log(" *mu*"mol " *cm^-2 *hr^-1*"))")),
    title = "Respiration stepwise Fitted Thermal Performance Curves (2026)"
  )
```
